long_biography.plain_text:
Richard E. "Rick" Schaden entered the restaurant business after college, opening a Quiznos franchise with his father in Boulder in 1987. Four years later they acquired the 18-store chain. As president, chief executive, chairman and majority shareholder, Schaden helped expand Quiznos through franchising into a large international sandwich brand.

After ending his operating tenure at Quiznos, Schaden founded SIF Partners, an investment and brand-development firm. He co-founded Smashburger in 2007 and later backed concepts including Tom's Watch Bar, while adding consumer, banking and real-estate investments. His current role combines chairmanship, capital allocation and hands-on development of new operating brands.
